baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.note: Backup, portable transfer, and salvage retain preset metadata verbatim; the salvage export constructor keeps structured output.

editor.note: Book creation offers three presets; short fiction placement and nonfiction labels and optional fiction tools follow the saved metadata.

encryption.no_impact: Preset metadata and single-scene formatting do not change archive encryption, keys, passwords, or protection behavior.
encryption.note: Preset metadata and single-scene formatting do not change archive encryption, keys, passwords, or protection behavior.

maintenance.note: Desktop creation commands and export renderers share preset defaults and single-scene behavior; recovery and transfer copying remain unchanged.

native-packaging.no_impact: Desktop preset behavior adds no dependencies, packaging configuration, or capability permissions and leaves native distribution unchanged.
native-packaging.note: Desktop preset behavior adds no dependencies, packaging configuration, or capability permissions and leaves native distribution unchanged.

project-format.note: Optional preset metadata preserves unknown values and selects starter structure; single-scene exports omit scaffold headings and contents.

schema.note: Preset metadata uses the existing meta table without changing schema version 17 or introducing a migration.
